test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**From among the words given in bold, select the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence.**

Jane Austen was already writing in the early 1790s, as the **debates** **raged **on** radicalism**, women's rights, and **premitivism.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is "**premitivism**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the** correct spelling** and **meaning **of the word:

 
 
• **Primitivism: **a belief in the value of what is simple and unsophisticated, expressed as a philosophy of life or through art or literature.

 
 
• ​**Example**: ***Primitivism **__was a key inspiration for a lot of painting schools such as cubism, fauvism and post-impressionism.*
 
 
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is **option 2.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the **other words**.

 
 
• ​**radicalism**: the beliefs or actions of people who advocate thorough or complete political or social reform.
 
• **raged**: feel or express violent uncontrollable anger.
 
• **debates**: an argument about a particular subject, especially one in which many people are involved.
 
 
 
• ​All the other words are **spelled correctly.​**
